_comment: Books used by the autotests, by role. 'fixture' books are generated by `npm run fixtures` into tools/fixtures/ and committed, so the tests run right after a clone. 'sample' books are optional real books in samples/ (not in the repository, they're copyrighted): DjVu can't be generated, and a real scan checks things a generated file can't. Tests that need a missing sample are skipped. 'about' says what the tests expect from a book.

fb2.about: Main FB2: 3 parts × 8 chapters, a footnote in every chapter, images, formatting, Ukrainian text

fb2Images.about: FB2 with many images of very different sizes and footnotes

epub.about: EPUB 3: nav and NCX, footnotes, images, book styles, unsafe markup to strip; the title differs from the file name

epubExtra.about: EPUB 2 with an NCX table of contents only

pdf.about: PDF with a text layer and a picture cover, no table of contents, a Latin file name

pdfScan.sample: Чандлер Д. Военные кампании Наполеона (1999), OCR.pdf
pdfScan.about: Optional: a scanned PDF with pages of different sizes

djvu.about: Optional: DjVu with a text layer, a table of contents and a picture on the cover

djvuLarge.about: Optional: a large DjVu (hundreds of pages) with a table of contents
